messages:
maria_support: Customer reports a March invoice spike — ~3x what they usually pay. Customer says usage doubled during a 90s outage window. Billing ID INV-4482. Can we triage?

sam: Can you paste sample request ids / idempotency keys from the customer logs?

maria_support: They've attached a redacted request log to ticket #7892. Sample lines: 
```
REQUEST id=req_0xF2a3 body={...} headers={Authorization:***, Content-Type:application/json} 
RESPONSE 200 token_count=4123
---
REQUEST id=req_0xF2a3 body={...} headers={Authorization:***} 
RESPONSE 200 token_count=4123
```
Note the second call has no Idempotency-Key header in that snippet.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4482 created 2025-03-12T14:02:10Z total_tokens=1,200,342 charged_tokens=1,200,342

jordan_oncall: I grep'd the ingest logs around that window. I see a 504 to the primary gateway at 14:01:28 -> gateway retried and routed to fallback pool. Both attempts reached the model server and were accepted, ledger entries created twice.

sam: That pattern = gateway-level retry + missing client idempotency header + ledger commit on each successful acceptance. If the SDK or client didn't set X-Idempotency-Key, retries to different pods will look like distinct requests.

tara_devex: Which SDK version did they use? Some older SDKs didn't attach Idempotency for streaming fallback cases.

maria_support: They say SDK v0.8.1 (npm). Customer code uses simple fetch wrapper — they expected platform to dedupe.

sam: Platform historically relied on Idempotency-Key for dedupe. We have a partial server-side protection for identical request signatures within 5s, but this case crossed 60s boundary because of retry backoff and queuing.

jordan_oncall: Logs excerpt (ingest node):
```
[14:01:27.998] ingress gateway=gw-3 receive req=req_0xF2a3 idempotency=NONE -> dispatch primary pod p-11
[14:01:28.452] p-11 RESP 504 (timeout) -> gateway triggers retry to fallback pool
[14:01:29.103] ingress gateway=gw-3 retry req=req_0xF2a3 idempotency=NONE -> dispatch fallback pod p-21
[14:01:29.845] p-21 RESP 200 tokens=4123 -> ledger write ledger_tx=ltx_9001
[14:01:29.900] delayed ack from p-11 arrives -> p-11 RESP 200 tokens=4123 -> ledger write ledger_tx=ltx_9002
```
Two ledger writes for same request id but no idempotency key.

maria_support: Customer is asking for a refund of the delta between expected and billed. They also want to know root cause and mitigation to avoid recurrence.

sam: Proposed immediate actions: 
1) Billing ops: compute duplicate ledger pairs for INV-4482 and credit customer for duplicate tokens (refund or credit).
2) Eng: emergency patch to gateway to always forward client-supplied X-Idempotency-Key and, on internal retries, reuse the same key header when retrying between pools.
3) Eng (medium): server-side dedupe enhancement — de-duplicate ledger writes for identical (client_id + request_hash) within 2m window.
4) DevEx: update SDK docs and publish patch guidance; create a quick patch to auto-generate and attach Idempotency-Key for single-request APIs.

tara_devex: I can cut a docs PR and a tiny npm patch to auto-add header for v0.8.x customers. Will target a hotfix.

jordan_oncall: Quick repro steps for Eng to validate locally: 
1) start local gateway with failover enabled
2) send a request w/o X-Idempotency-Key that triggers a 504 on primary (we can simulate with short timeout)
3) ensure fallback pod accepts -> expect two ledger writes unless dedupe is active
Commands: 
```bash
# simulate primary timeout
export GW_FAIL_PRIMARY=1
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TEST_KEY}" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' http://local-gateway/complete
```

sam: For the refund calc: Billing ops, please diff ledger_tx pairs matching identical request hash and same client_id within the outage window 2025-03-12T14:01:20Z..14:03:00Z. Tag duplicates and sum duplicate token_counts.

billing-bot: Marking INV-4482 as under_review_by=billing_ops ticket_ref=BILL-1294

maria_support: I'll notify the customer that we're investigating and will issue credit if duplicate ledger entries confirmed.

eng-deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: gateway-hotfix/forward-idempotency -> canary at 2025-03-12T19:00Z (ETA 1h)

sam: After the hotfix, we should run a synthetic flood test to validate dedupe on failover path. Also audit other ingress proxies (edge, private) for consistent header forwarding.

tara_devex: I'll prepare a customer-facing KB with recommended SDK upgrade and a short note explaining why setting Idempotency-Key matters.

maria_support: AC: refund/credit issued OR clear rationale provided + eng fixes in canary + docs PR opened. I'll keep customer in the loop. :eyes:
